MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hook-and-loop strips fit my practical repair interests because they offer removable fastening alongside the duct tape and vinyl cement I have used.",
    "The assorted heat-shrink tubing and crimp connectors complement my previous spade terminals by helping insulate connections and make sealed inline wire repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The temperature controller assumes a project I have not shown a need for, while the nuts and large tubing require exact dimensions I have no current use for.",
    "Ten tubes of glue and a large thin-adhesive refill exceed my current needs; having used adhesives does not mean every formulation or quantity is useful to me.",
    "Several connector kits could fit my interests, but I would choose one suitable kit rather than buy overlapping supplies together."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in repair supplies seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for specialized equipment and narrowly sized parts.",
    "My previous adhesive and connector purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to suggest more of the same without enough attention to quantity or overlapping uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "For general repairs, an assortment is more useful to me than a large quantity of one exact size unless I have a matching job.",
    "A useful next purchase should add a capability to supplies I already have, such as removable fastening or insulation for wire connections.",
    "I buy when there is a clear practical fit; related tools and materials alone do not establish a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but sometimes confused related supplies with a current need for specific sizes, bulk quantities, or specialized projects."
}
